title: Meditate 10 minutes per day.
subtitle: Mindfulness floor
rationale: Build a small daily attention practice before judging whether meditation earns a bigger slot.
tierTarget: 10 minutes of meditation on most days

evidence.summary: Meta-analytic evidence shows mindfulness programs produce small-to-moderate improvements in anxiety, depression, and stress; brief daily practice shows measurable attention and mood effects in trials.

sources.label: Meditation programs systematic review and meta-analysis

indications: Stress recovery relies entirely on physical levers.
Attention feels scattered even in protected blocks.
Meditation apps get installed and abandoned.
